propositions: Leaf tickets drift from their parent's declared plan scope during claim/edit, detected only at epic close; no current criterion validates a leaf plan against its parent's plan.
A new AGENT-tier criterion G7 must fire only on leaf tickets with a parent, reading the parent ticket at runtime via show_ticket tool and checking that leaf deliverables are a subset of parent scope.

Routing must implement a new applies_at axis require_parent_id (boolean) validated in overlay.py::_validate_routing_entry, threaded through orchestrator.route_criteria, firing G7 only when (parent_id exists AND no children AND not bug/session_log).

G7's rubric must encode the parent-wins rule and instruct the agent to call show_ticket(parent_id) to compare leaf scope; findings fire when leaf contradicts parent AC, delivers out-of-parent-scope items, or redefines deliverables differently.

G7 ships advisory (0.95 posture) with fire-rate observable in REVIEW_RESULT sidecars; a committed docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/g7-promotion-path.md file documents the jq promotion-path query and 0.6–0.7 promotion band, with actual promotion decision deferred.
